  4. Can now submit posts (links and regular). Preview pane available to view what the post will look like
  5. Added plumbing for settings storage, just need to populate what will be user configurable

Since the Windows Phone VM hasn't been playing nice, I'm attempting right now to make things work on a physical machine, rather than a virtual one. Once this is working, actual phone layout testing will begin. Still thinking I can have this all ready before the W10 release, but I'm not sure that the Voat API will be released before that. The beta API also has a throttling policy, so all the web calls are artificially delayed in order to prevent triggering the throttle warnings. As a result of this, browsing isn't quite as smooth as I'd like (ie. 3-5 seconds for the subverse page to load, rather than the 1-2 it takes without the delay).
